title: Risk-stratification machine learning model using demographic factors, gynaecological symptoms and beta-catenin for endometrial hyperplasia and carcinoma: a cross-sectional study.
authors: Masadah, Rina; Maulana, Aries; Nelwan, Berti Julian; Ghaznawie, Mahmud; Miskad, Upik Anderiani; Tawali, Suryani; Rauf, Syahrul; Herman, Bumi
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用人口学特征、妇科症状和β-catenin免疫组化构建子宫内膜增生/癌的风险分层机器学习模型，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Demographic features, suggestive gynaecological symptoms, and immunohistochemical expression of endometrial beta-catenin have a prognostic capacity for endometrial hyperplasia and carcinoma. This study assessed the interaction of all variables and developed risk stratification for endometrial hyperplasia and carcinoma. METHODS: This cross-sectional study was conducted from January 2023 to July 2023 at two teaching hospitals in Makassar Indonesia. Patients (< 70 years old) with suggestive symptoms of endometrial hyperplasia or carcinoma or being referred with disease code N.85 who underwent curettage and/or surgery for pathology assessment except those receiving radiotherapy, or chemotherapy, presence of another carcinoma, coagulation disorder, and history of anti-inflammatory drug use and unreadable samples. Demographic, and clinical symptoms were collected from medical records. Immunohistochemistry staining using mouse-monoclonal antibodies determined the beta-catenin expression (percentage, intensity, and H-score) in endometrial tissues. Ordinal and Binary Logistic regression identified the potential predictors to be included in neural networks and decision tree models of histopathological grading according to the World Health Organization/WHO grading classification. RESULTS: Abdominal enlargement was associated with worse pathological grading (adjusted odds ratio/aOR 6.7 95% CI 1.8-24.8). Increasing age (aOR 1.1 95% CI 1.03-1.2) and uterus bleeding (aOR 5.3 95% CI 1.3-21.6) were associated with carcinoma but not with %beta-catenin and H-Score. However, adjusted by vaginal bleeding and body mass index, lower %beta-catenin (aOR 1.03 95% 1.01-1.05) was associated with non-atypical hyperplasia, as well as H-Score (aOR 1.01 95% CI 1.01-1.02). Neural networks and Decision tree risk stratification showed a sensitivity of 80-94.8% and a specificity of 40.6-60% in differentiating non-atypical from atypical and carcinoma. A cutoff of 55% beta-catenin area and H-Score of 110, along with other predictors could distinguish non-atypical samples from atypical and carcinoma. CONCLUSION: Risk stratification based on demographics, clinical symptoms, and beta-catenin possesses a good performance in differentiating non-atypical hyperplasia with later stages.
abstract_zh: 背景：人口学特征、提示性妇科症状以及子宫内膜β-catenin的免疫组织化学表达对子宫内膜增生和癌具有预后能力。本研究评估了所有变量的相互作用，并开发了子宫内膜增生和癌的风险分层。方法：本横断面研究于2023年1月至2023年7月在印度尼西亚望加锡的两所教学医院进行。纳入年龄小于70岁、有提示性子宫内膜增生或癌症状、或转诊时带有疾病代码N.85、并接受刮宫和/或手术进行病理评估的患者，但排除接受放疗或化疗、存在其他癌、凝血功能障碍、有抗炎药物使用史以及样本不可读者。人口学和临床症状从医疗记录中收集。使用小鼠单克隆抗体进行免疫组织化学染色，以确定子宫内膜组织中β-catenin的表达（百分比、强度和H评分）。采用有序和二元Logistic回归识别潜在预测因子，纳入神经网络和决策树模型，以根据世界卫生组织（WHO）分级分类进行组织病理学分级。结果：腹部增大与更差的病理分级相关（调整后优势比/aOR 6.7，95% CI 1.8-24.8）。年龄增加（aOR 1.1，95% CI 1.03-1.2）和子宫出血（aOR 5.3，95% CI 1.3-21.6）与癌相关，但与%β-catenin和H评分无关。然而，在调整阴道出血和体重指数后，较低的%β-catenin（aOR 1.03，95% CI 1.01-1.05）与非典型增生相关，H评分也是如此（aOR 1.01，95% CI 1.01-1.02）。神经网络和决策树风险分层在区分非典型与不典型及癌时，敏感性为80-94.8%，特异性为40.6-60%。β-catenin面积55%和H评分110的截断值，连同其他预测因子，能够区分非典型样本与不典型及癌。结论：基于人口学特征、临床症状和β-catenin的风险分层在区分非典型增生与后期阶段方面具有良好的性能。
